sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

WITH emp_orders AS (SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id, e.name) SELECT employee_name FROM emp_orders WHERE total_orders >= 10 ORDER BY (cancelled_orders * 1.0 / total_orders) DESC, employee_name LIMIT 1

SELECT emp.name FROM (SELECT e.id, e.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(rt.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id AND o.status = 'delivered' WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3) emp

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM( (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - (oi.quantity * p.cost) ) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3
SELECT ci.name AS city FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Ghamdi Logistics'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01'

SELECT c.segment FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY (SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)) DESC, c.segment LIMIT 1

WITH shipped AS (
  SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS ym, oi.id AS order_item_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id
  WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
), stats AS (
  SELECT ym,
         COUNT(*) AS shipped_item_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN rt.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_item_lines
  FROM shipped sh
  LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = sh.order_item_id
  GROUP BY ym
)
SELECT ym
FROM stats
WHERE shipped_item_lines > 0
ORDER BY (returned_item_lines * 1.0 / shipped_item_lines) DESC, ym
LIMIT 1;

WITH line_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    o.employee_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS delivered_revenue,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS refund_amount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
    AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09','10','11','12')
  GROUP BY o.employee_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    e.name AS employee_name,
    (delivered_revenue - refund_amount) AS net_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (delivered_revenue - refund_amount) DESC, e.name) AS rn
  FROM line_rev lr
  JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id
)
SELECT employee_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY rn;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Makkah'

WITH shipped AS (
  SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id, o.order_date
  FROM orders o
  JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025'
), per_month AS (
  SELECT substr(sh.order_date,1,7) AS ym,
         COUNT(rt.id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(sh.order_item_id), 0) AS return_ratio
  FROM shipped sh
  LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = sh.order_item_id
  GROUP BY substr(sh.order_date,1,7)
)
SELECT ym AS answer_month
FROM per_month
ORDER BY return_ratio DESC, ym ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Asir'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Stationery' AND p.active = 1
SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0012'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND substr(opened_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06'

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-04','2025-05','2025-06') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Household' AND p.active = 1

SELECT c.name FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT ci.id AS city_id, ci.name AS name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name) AS rn FROM cities ci JOIN customers cu ON cu.city_id = ci.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10','11','12') AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY ci.id) WHERE rn = 1
SELECT MAX(p.unit_price) AS highest_unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Bakery'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
SELECT ci.name AS city FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Mohammed Al-Ghamdi' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'wallet' AND substr(paid_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-03'

SELECT cu.segment FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, cu.segment LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_at) - julianday(s.shipped_at)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments s WHERE s.carrier = 'DHL' AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND topic = 'billing'

WITH y AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'), n AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2026') SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM y JOIN n ON y.customer_id = n.customer_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2024-01','2024-02','2024-03','2024-04','2024-05','2024-06')

WITH global AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24.0) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), per_customer AS (SELECT cu.id AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.order_id) AS orders_with_tickets, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24.0) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets st JOIN orders o ON o.id = st.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM per_customer pc CROSS JOIN global g WHERE pc.orders_with_tickets >= 5 AND pc.avg_hours > g.avg_hours
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Qassim'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2026') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN substr(order_date,1,4)='2026' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) x
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) IN ('2024-01','2024-02','2024-03','2024-04','2024-05','2024-06') THEN '2024H1' WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) IN ('2025-01','2025-02','2025-03','2025-04','2025-05','2025-06') THEN '2025H1' END AS half, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS delivered_revenue FROM regions r JOIN cities ci ON ci.region_id = r.id JOIN customers c ON c.city_id = ci.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND (substr(o.order_date,1,7) IN ('2024-01','2024-02','2024-03','2024-04','2024-05','2024-06','2025-01','2025-02','2025-03','2025-04','2025-05','2025-06')) GROUP BY r.id, half), agg AS (SELECT region_id, MAX(CASE WHEN half='2024H1' THEN delivered_revenue END) AS rev_2024_h1, MAX(CASE WHEN half='2025H1' THEN delivered_revenue END) AS rev_2025_h1 FROM rev GROUP BY region_id) SELECT r.name FROM agg a JOIN regions r ON r.id = a.region_id WHERE a.rev_2024_h1 IS NOT NULL AND a.rev_2024_h1 <> 0 ORDER BY ((a.rev_2025_h1 - a.rev_2024_h1) / a.rev_2024_h1) ASC, r.name LIMIT 1

WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24.0) AS overall_avg_hours
  FROM support_tickets
  WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
), cust AS (
  SELECT st.customer_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT st.order_id) AS closed_order_count,
         AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24.0) AS cust_avg_hours
  FROM support_tickets st
  WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY st.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM cust
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE cust.closed_order_count >= 2
  AND cust.cust_avg_hours > overall.overall_avg_hours;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03','04','05','06') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND ci.name IN ('Duba','Dubai') ORDER BY e.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND substr(paid_at, 1, 4) = '2024' AND CAST(substr(paid_at, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12
SELECT MAX(p.unit_price) AS max_unit_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Snacks'

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10','11','12') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, substr(o.order_date,1,4) AS yr, CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,6,2) IN ('01','02','03','04','05','06') THEN 'H1' END AS half, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS delivered_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,6,2) IN ('01','02','03','04','05','06') THEN 'H1' END = 'H1' GROUP BY r.id, yr) SELECT (SELECT name FROM regions rr WHERE rr.id = x.region_id) AS region_name FROM (SELECT region_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr='2024' THEN delivered_revenue END),0)=0 THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr='2025' THEN delivered_revenue END),0)>0 THEN 1e18 ELSE 0 END ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr='2025' THEN delivered_revenue END),0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr='2024' THEN delivered_revenue END),0)) / COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr='2024' THEN delivered_revenue END),0) END AS growth_pct FROM rev GROUP BY region_id ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, region_id LIMIT 1) x;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise'

SELECT x.name FROM (
  SELECT p.id, p.name,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - (oi.quantity * p.cost)) AS margin
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025'
    AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09')
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
) x
ORDER BY x.margin DESC, x.name
LIMIT 3
